title: Interior Schauder bootstrap for Δw = div(B[Dw] + g) with small coefficient perturbation: B, g ∈ C^{l,α}_loc ⇒ w ∈ C^{l+1,α}_loc
statement: Let m ≥ 1, k ∈ ℕ and 0 < α < 1. There is ε₁ > 0 such that for every open Ω ⊆ ℝ^m, every l ∈ ℕ, every w : ℝ^m → ℝ^k which is C¹ on Ω, every B : ℝ^m → L(L(ℝ^m, ℝ^k), L(ℝ^m, ℝ^k)) with ‖B(x)‖ ≤ ε₁ on Ω, and every g : ℝ^m → L(ℝ^m, ℝ^k), if B and g belong to C^{l,α}_loc(Ω) (C^l on Ω with locally α-Hölder l-th derivative, in the sense of the holder_algebra node) and Δw = div(B[Dw] + g) weakly in Ω, i.e. ∫_Ω Σ_j ⟨Dw e_j, Dζ e_j⟩ = ∫_Ω Σ_j ⟨(B[Dw] + g)e_j, Dζ e_j⟩ for every C¹ map ζ with compact support and tsupport ζ ⊆ Ω, then w ∈ C^{l+1,α}_loc(Ω).
lean_statement: ∀ (m k : ℕ) (α : ℝ), 1 ≤ m → 0 < α → α < 1 → ∃ ε₁ : ℝ, 0 < ε₁ ∧ ∀ (Ω : Set (Euclid m)) (l : ℕ) (w : Euclid m → Euclid k) (B : Euclid m → ((Euclid m →L[ℝ] Euclid k) →L[ℝ] (Euclid m →L[ℝ] Euclid k))) (g : Euclid m → (Euclid m →L[ℝ] Euclid k)), IsOpen Ω → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 w Ω → (∀ x ∈ Ω, ‖B x‖ ≤ ε₁) → (ContDiffOn ℝ l B Ω ∧ ∀ x ∈ Ω, ∃ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ ∧ ball x ρ ⊆ Ω ∧ ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ y ∈ ball x ρ, ∀ z ∈ ball x ρ, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ l B y - iteratedFDeriv ℝ l B z‖ ≤ C * ‖y - z‖ ^ α) → (ContDiffOn ℝ l g Ω ∧ ∀ x ∈ Ω, ∃ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ ∧ ball x ρ ⊆ Ω ∧ ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ y ∈ ball x ρ, ∀ z ∈ ball x ρ, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ l g y - iteratedFDeriv ℝ l g z‖ ≤ C * ‖y - z‖ ^ α) → (∀ ζ : Euclid m → Euclid k, ContDiff ℝ 1 ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ Ω → ∫ x in Ω, ∑ j : Fin m, inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ w x (EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ))) (fderiv ℝ ζ x (EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ))) = ∫ x in Ω, ∑ j : Fin m, inner ℝ ((B x (fderiv ℝ w x) + g x) (EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ))) (fderiv ℝ ζ x (EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ)))) → (ContDiffOn ℝ (l + 1) w Ω ∧ ∀ x ∈ Ω, ∃ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ ∧ ball x ρ ⊆ Ω ∧ ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ y ∈ ball x ρ, ∀ z ∈ ball x ρ, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ (l + 1) w y - iteratedFDeriv ℝ (l + 1) w z‖ ≤ C * ‖y - z‖ ^ α)
